create_model_runner: create a ModelRunner instance to run SSD speculative decoding on a target or draft LLM model
run_model_inference: run the ModelRunner with sequences for prefill or decode steps and return sampled token IDs
allocate_kv_cache: allocate GPU KV cache for the model based on free memory and block configuration
setup_model_and_cudagraphs: setup and warmup the target or draft model with CUDA graphs for accelerated inference
run_model_with_eagle: run model inference with EAGLE3 speculative decoding using hidden states for draft conditioning
